name: Gamify
description: adds gamification (points, rewards) to the community UI via ECA and User Points.
project_description:
The module is intended to provide an easily accessible option to increase user-interaction by gamification. It can be used to manage user points for creating, editing and deleting entities. In addition, an API is provided to generally create simple validatable rules as config. - 

 Important Information 
 Since the User Points module is not maintained. A clone of the User Points module is included as sub module, to include the required updates for D9+D10.
